scope: FROZEN RESEARCH, 7 November 2026. $250k/month x 12; $100M research balance sheet, original target 76.39% cash and 10% unsold property. Synthetic paths fitted to actual-history inputs; not historical OOS. 5bps per buy/sell and 1 week settlement are assumptions. Not recomputed by edited controls. No default change.
takeaway: Annual/no within-year rebalancing ranks first of four frequencies in validation and all four final laws. One-year horizon and cash-heavy target only; not a proven long-run optimum. All 16 frequency/law final rows pass this conditional screen. Lower-drift paired intervals can overlap zero.
dynamic_takeaway: No proven best dynamic rule. Eight-parameter feedback search: 360 evaluations; primary feedback passes two nominal laws but fails lower drift. Same first trade then no feedback beats repeated feedback in post-hoc attribution. Exploratory robust search: 40 training-feasible candidates, NONE of the top 12 passes all four validation laws. Fresh final feedback and first-trade-only policies fail both lower-drift laws; three simple baselines pass all four.
